context: A boss and manager talk about a corporate health crisis
purpose: Teach: 犯行/孤立/敗北/臓器/発症/投与/危惧/及ぼし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場周辺で、健康被害の発症が報じられている。
lines.en: Health effects are being reported in the area around the plant.
lines.style: Measured opening. Precise diction, slight weight on 'being reported'—clinical distance masking concern. Steady eye contact. The tone of a leader choosing his words carefully for the record.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。孤立した集落から、医療敗北の声まで。
lines.en: Yes. From isolated villages to voices saying the medical system has failed them.
lines.style: Quiet documentation. Slight pause before 'even voices'—absorbing the weight of what he's saying. No editorializing. Just laying facts out for his superior to see.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の薬剤投与で、社員の臓器に影響を及ぼした例もあった。
lines.en: There have been cases where past chemical exposure affected our employees' organs.
lines.style: Firm, unflinching. No softening. Slight emphasis on 'have been'—acknowledging precedent without excuse. The voice of someone stating what must be stated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 外部の専門家も、長期的影響を危惧しています。
lines.en: Outside experts are concerned about the long-term effects as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause mid-sentence. Measured delivery, building toward the weight of expert consensus. Not defensive—reporting what the data shows.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 公的犯行ではないが、説明責任は果たそう。
lines.en: It's not a matter of state law, but we will take responsibility.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. Hard stop on 'responsibility'—finality and commitment in the same syllable. Lower register. The decision has been made and this is him saying it aloud to make it real.
